limitations: Only exact application updater/wait/pack32 instructions execute. All Core, C library, FirmwareBundle stream and virtual post calls are explicit bounded emulated boundaries.
Stack image tail initialized to zero and retains previous block data; no arbitrary uninitialized native tail equivalence.
Ordinary original returns, layout, ARM ABI, exceptions, hardware and concurrency unverified.
Native waitResponseSet delegated contract only; actual source provider replay is separate.
Native negative read has unsafe/unbounded behavior and is excluded; portable fail-closed adaptation is separately tested.
